Name: Emily Sprite Redux
Author: thejesse081
Description:
Emily's original sprite was just the worst. Her portrait looks like a completely different blue-haired person. So I completely re-did her and now she looks less like your lonely divorced aunt and more like a free spirited college dropout fashionista.

Goes well with DCBurgers Hi-Res Pack (which was honestly what I made this for) https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/888

If you guys want me to do another Redux then feel free to ask. Not gonna promise I'll do it, but I might.
